newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine carrier says Russia delays Moscow flight.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine carrier says Russia delays Moscow flight.

text.p: Ukraine's private Aerosweet airline on Thursday accused Russian civil aviation authorities of hindering its plan to open a route between Kiev and Moscow and said it had postponed the inaugural flight for the third time.
Serhy Panasenko, head of Aerosweet's passenger department, said the company now planned to launch flights on October 27. It had initially hoped to start them in July.

"We still have not started serving Moscow route despite placing advertisements and achieving what we thought was an agreement," Panasenko said by telephone. "Unfortunately there are some obstacles from the Russian side."
Aerosweet operates a single leased Boeing 737 on flights to Israel, Greece, Russia, the Baltic state of Latvia and the former Soviet republics of Kazakhstan and Turkmenistan.

Russia's private carrier Transaero currently operates two daily flights between Kiev and Moscow as does state-owned Air Ukraine. Russia's flagship carrier Aeroflot has a single flight. --Rostislav Khotin, Kiev newsroom, +380 44 229 2264
